action: Starts from a plain sphere and cuts it into large flat facets with an angled slice stroke.
tool: Slice/Trim curve on DynaMesh sphere (overlay 'SLICE Angle=157')
why: Turn the sphere into a faceted head with cranium, cheek and jaw planes.
reader_equivalent: UV sphere -> Voxel Remesh -> Trim Line / Line Project gestures or bisect plane cuts.

action: With the planar face block done (stepped brow/mouth shelf, pyramidal nose facet), pulls a point up from the top of the head with a soft brush.
why: Adjust the cranium silhouette after the planar cuts.
reader_equivalent: Grab / Elastic Deform, then voxel remesh.

action: Opens a large wide mouth with a tongue, softens the head, and moves a separate ear into place with the gizmo.
why: Ears are separate pieces placed by transform; mouth shape is blocked as a big open cavity early.
reader_equivalent: Separate ear object moved with G/R/S or Grab; mouth cavity carved with Draw (inverted) / Clay Strips subtract.

action: Scratches the big round anime eyes, brows, hairline and fringe as shallow guide lines straight onto the soft head.
why: Mark large round eye placement and hair layout as a sketch on the clay before modelling them.
reader_equivalent: Draw/Crease brush with small radius, or Annotate tool on surface as a guide.

action: Uses the gizmo to adjust masked regions (ear from below, then mouth/teeth area) on a cleaner head with eyes drawn as dark line work, round irises, brows and lashes.
why: Reposition features as whole pieces rather than re-sculpting them.
reader_equivalent: Mask + Sculpt-mode Transform/Move gizmo, or Mask then G/R/S in sculpt mode.

action: Shows the finished Nezuko figure: long hair as separate flowing locks, hair ribbon, kimono with layered panels and checker obi with blocky bands.
